displayPattern: Front-load washer display shows F9 E1
meaning: Slow drain: drain times are longer than expected, typically over eight minutes.
causes: Drain hose not set up with the U-shaped form, or standpipe height outside the allowed range
diySteps: Make sure the drain hose is not kinked or clogged
Use the U-shaped drain hose form on the drain hose
Check the standpipe (drainpipe) height: 39 in (99 cm) minimum and 96 in (244 cm) maximum
Use HE (high efficiency) detergent, since excessive suds can also delay draining
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If the code returns after these checks, contact Whirlpool or schedule service online.
